delivery.title: Delivery and payment
delivery.intro: We deliver to all eight governorates. You pay the driver in cash when your order arrives — nothing is charged online, and we never ask for card details.
delivery.feesNote: The exact price is shown at checkout once you choose your governorate, and the order is written with that number.
delivery.how1: You place the order. Nothing is charged and nothing leaves the shop yet.
delivery.how2: We call the number you gave us, confirm what you ordered, and agree a day with you.
delivery.how3: The driver brings your order and you pay in cash, then.
delivery.timingBody: We agree the day on the phone before anything leaves the shop, so you are never waiting on a delivery you did not expect. If we cannot reach you, the order waits rather than turning up unannounced.
delivery.checkBody: Open the box before you pay. If the item is damaged, the wrong one, or not what you ordered, hand it straight back and pay nothing.

returns.title: Returns and exchanges
returns.intro: If something is wrong with what we brought you, we put it right.
returns.doorBody: Open the box with the driver before you pay. If the item is damaged, the wrong one, or not what you ordered, hand it back and pay nothing. That is the simplest way to sort it out and it costs you nothing.
returns.afterBody: Call us within seven days and we will arrange a replacement or give back what you paid. Keep the box and everything that came inside it.
returns.notBody: Anything you damaged after it was delivered, and anything returned without the cables, chargers or accessories it came with. A fault that appears on its own is not damage — tell us and we will look at it.
returns.rightsNote: These are our own promises. They are not a limit on your legal rights.
returns.howBody: Call us with your order number. It looks like T4T-26-000042 and it is shown on the confirmation page right after you order — write it down, because nothing is sent to you afterwards. If you do not have it, the phone number you ordered with is enough to find your order.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.intro: How buying from this shop works, in plain terms.
terms.whoBody: Taz4Tech, an electronics shop selling to customers in Lebanon. Our name and phone number are at the bottom of every page, and our commercial registration number appears there once the business is registered.
terms.pricesBody: Prices are in US dollars and include VAT where it applies. The price you see at checkout is the price your order is written with — if a price changes afterwards, it does not change an order already placed.
terms.orderBody: An order is a request until we confirm it on the phone. If something you ordered has sold out between your order and that call, we tell you then and you pay nothing for it.
terms.paymentBody: Cash on delivery only, paid to the driver in US dollars. We do not take card payments, and nobody from this shop will ever ask you for card or bank details.
terms.cancelBody: Call us before the driver leaves and we will cancel the order at no cost to you.
terms.rightsBody: Everything on this page and on the returns page is what this shop promises you. None of it reduces the rights Lebanese consumer protection law gives you, and where the two differ, the law is what counts.
terms.changesBody: If these terms change, the version on this page is the one that applies to orders placed after it appears. An order already placed keeps the terms it was placed under.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: We keep as little as possible, and only what is needed to bring you your order.
privacy.whatBody: Your name, your phone number, your delivery address and what you ordered. There are no accounts here and no passwords, so there is nothing else to hold.
privacy.whyBody: To call you before delivering, to get the driver to your door, and to answer questions about an order later.
privacy.shareBody: The driver bringing your order. We do not sell your details, and we do not send marketing you did not ask for.
privacy.cookiesBody: One cookie holds your basket so it survives a reload. It is not used to follow you around, there is nothing else stored on your device, and there is no consent banner because there is nothing to consent to.
privacy.askBody: Call us and ask. We keep records of completed orders for accounting, so an order you have already received may have to stay on file.

contact.whatsappBody: The same number takes WhatsApp messages. Send one and we reply as soon as we can.
